sample_unit: cases (phase 1: 58 consecutive patients; phase 2: 40 biopsy patients)
models_evaluated: Publicly available AI model for prostate organ and intraprostatic lesion segmentation on mpMRI, containerized for MONAI Deploy Express

links.outcome: Local AI segmentation performance versus expert radiologist annotation and independent validation studies
links.effect: Comparison with expert radiologist annotation showed stable model performance compared with independent validation studies; no local performance drop reported.
links.quote: Comparison with expert radiologist annotation demonstrated stable model performance compared to independent validation studies.

unlisted_practices: Containerized deployment of the AI model within clinical PACS via an inference server, launched by the radiologist
Integration of AI segmentation outputs into biopsy planning software for target definition

screen.reason: The study prospective evaluates the integration of an AI segmentation pipeline into a clinical PACS environment with point-of-care radiologist review and acceptance for biopsy targeting.

primary.practice: PACS integration and clinician review/acceptance workflow
